OldWestTown.Rivals.RivalTownDef.label: Two Forks
OldWestTown.Rivals.RivalTownDef.description: A settled town a few days' ride out, with a main street of its own and no particular hurry about anything. It doesn't undercut you often, but when it does, it means it.

OldWestTown.Rivals.RivalTownDef.label: Prospect Junction
OldWestTown.Rivals.RivalTownDef.description: A scrappy camp-turned-town that never stopped acting like it's still fighting for its first customer. A smaller ceiling than Two Forks, but a shorter fuse on a price war.
